caption: The video captures an outdoor grassy clearing under a clear sky, where a large open fire burns a pile of wooden planks and debris at left-center, sending dark smoke drifting upward and leftward. The flames flicker and reshape continuously across the segment, while the tree line, horizon, and a haystack at right remain fixed, indicating a largely static camera. In the left foreground lies a light-blue quilted mattress beside a rusty metal bar resting on the grass. In the first frames the mattress rests flat, showing its horizontal top surface and rounded white piping. As the excerpt progresses, the mattress tilts and rises into an upright position along the left edge, revealing its vertical quilted side face. This reorientation gradually occludes the lower-left base of the burning pile. The fire itself keeps burning throughout. The mattress remains standing through the later frames, with no visible operator or mechanism causing the movement.
